title: The Weather Today and Yesterday
text:
Today the weather is very nice. The sun is shining and the sky is blue. It is warm and there is no wind. It is a good day for a walk.

Yesterday it was cold and rainy. There were many clouds all day. It was windy too. Tomorrow it will be cloudy, but it will not rain.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What was the weather like yesterday?
Why is today a good day for a walk?
options: It is too dark to see

questions.text: What can we guess about tomorrow?
options: It will probably be sunny and hot
It will probably not rain, so umbrellas are not needed
It will be snowing all day
The sky will be completely clear

vocabulary.definition: with many clouds in the sky
a little hot in a pleasant way

paragraph_translations: Сьогодні погода дуже гарна. Сонце сяє, а небо блакитне. Тепло, і вітру немає. Це гарний день для прогулянки.
Вчора було холодно і дощово. Цілий день було багато хмар. Також було вітряно. Завтра буде хмарно, але дощу не буде.
